```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

## Introduction

This document visualizes relationships between countries based on mentions in their background information. The network graph shows how countries are connected, with node sizes representing the number of connections and colors representing continents.

```{r libraries, echo=FALSE}
library(readr)      # For reading CSV files
library(RColorBrewer)  # For color palettes
library(igraph)     # For network visualization
library(visNetwork) # For interactive network visualization
```

```{r data_loading, echo=FALSE} 
# Load the CSV file
countries_data <- read_csv("/home/luisa/Documents/University/BHT/Data Visualization/BHTDataVisualizationCourse/data/clean_data.csv")

# Convert the CSV data to a more usable format
countries <- list()
for (i in 1:nrow(countries_data)) {
  country_name <- countries_data$Country[i]
  countries[[country_name]] <- as.list(countries_data[i, -1])  # Exclude the country column
}

# Remove "World" from the list of countries if it exists
if ("World" %in% names(countries)) {
  countries <- countries[names(countries) != "World"]
}
```

```{r define_relationships, echo=FALSE}
# Create a data structure to store country relationships
country_relationships <- list()

# Define alternative names for certain countries
country_alternatives <- list(
  "United Kingdom" = c("Britain", "UK", "England", "British"),
  "United States" = c("USA", "US"),
  "China" = c("PRC", "Chinese", "Chin"),
  "Turkey (Turkiye)" = c("Turkiye", "Turkey", "Turkish"),
  "Congo, Democratic Republic of the" = c("DRC", "DR Congo", "Congo-Kinshasa", "Congo republics"),
  "Congo, Republic of the" = c("Congo-Brazzaville", "Congo republics"),
  "Czechia" = c("Czech Republic", "Czech"),
  "Eswatini" = c("Swaziland", "Swazee"),
  "Burma" = c("Myanmar", "Burmese"),
  "Holy See (Vatican City)" = c("Vatican", "Vatican City"),
  "Micronesia, Federated States of" = c("FSM", "Micronesia"),
  "Gambia, The" = c("The Gambia", "Gambia"),
  "Bahamas, The" = c("The Bahamas", "Bahamas"),
  "Korea, North" = c("North Korea", "DPRK"),
  "Korea, South" = c("South Korea", "ROK"),
  "Timor-Leste" = c("East Timor"),
  "Taiwan" = c("Republic of China", "ROC"),
  "Vietnam" = c("Viet Nam"),
  "Germany" = c("German"),
  "France" = c("French"),
  "Italy" = c("Italian"),
  "Spain" = c("Spanish"),
  "Portugal" = c("Portuguese"),
  "Greece" = c("Greek"),
  "Netherlands" = c("Dutch"),
  "Belgium" = c("Belgian"),
  "Sweden" = c("Swedish"),
  "Norway" = c("Norwegian"),
  "Denmark" = c("Danish"),
  "Finland" = c("Finnish"),
  "Switzerland" = c("Swiss"),
  "Poland" = c("Polish"),
  "Hungary" = c("Hungarian")
)

# For each country, find which other countries are mentioned in its background
for (country_name in names(countries)) {
  country_background <- countries[[country_name]]$`Introduction..Background`
  related_countries <- c()
  
  if (!is.null(country_background) && !is.na(country_background)) {
    # Check for mentions of each other country
    for (other_country in names(countries)) {
      # Skip self-references
      if (other_country != country_name) {
        # Check if the other country name appears in the background
        if (grepl(other_country, country_background, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
          related_countries <- c(related_countries, other_country)
        } else {
          # Check alternative names if they exist for this country
          if (other_country %in% names(country_alternatives)) {
            for (alt_name in country_alternatives[[other_country]]) {
              if (grepl(alt_name, country_background, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
                related_countries <- c(related_countries, other_country)
                break  # Found a match, no need to check other alternatives
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Store the relationships for this country
  country_relationships[[country_name]] <- related_countries
}
```

```{r create_matrix, echo=FALSE}
# Convert the relationships to a matrix format
countries_list <- unique(names(country_relationships))
n_countries <- length(countries_list)

# Get continent information for each country
country_continents <- sapply(countries_list, function(country) {
  continent <- countries[[country]]$`Geography..Map.references`
  if(is.null(continent) || is.na(continent)) {
    return("Unknown")
  } else {
    # Standardize continent names
    if(continent == "Central America and the Caribbean") {
      return("Central America")
    } else {
      return(continent)
    }
  }
})

# Create and fill the relationship matrix
relationship_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = n_countries, ncol = n_countries)
rownames(relationship_matrix) <- countries_list
colnames(relationship_matrix) <- countries_list

for (i in 1:n_countries) {
  country_name <- countries_list[i]
  related_countries <- country_relationships[[country_name]]
  
  for (related in related_countries) {
    if (related %in% countries_list) {
      j <- which(countries_list == related)
      relationship_matrix[i, j] <- relationship_matrix[i, j] + 1
    }
  }
}

# Filter to include only countries with relationships
has_relationships <- rowSums(relationship_matrix) > 0 | colSums(relationship_matrix) > 0
filtered_matrix <- relationship_matrix[has_relationships, has_relationships]
filtered_countries <- countries_list[has_relationships]
filtered_continents <- country_continents[has_relationships]
```

## Create Network Visualization

```{r network_plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=10, echo=FALSE}
# Create an igraph object
g <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(filtered_matrix, mode = "directed", weighted = TRUE)

# Set vertex attributes for continents
V(g)$continent <- filtered_continents

# Define continent colors
continent_colors <- c(
  "North America" = "#0D47A1",    # Dark blue
  "Europe" = "#1976D2",           # Medium blue
  "Asia" = "#B71C1C",             # Dark red
  "Southeast Asia" = "#E57373",   # Lighter red
  "Middle East" = "#E65100",      # Orange
  "Africa" = "#2E7D32",           # Green
  "Central America" = "#FBC02D",  # Yellow
  "South America" = "#F9A825",    # Darker yellow
  "AsiaEurope" = "#6A1B9A",       # Purple
  "Oceania" = "#00838F",          # Teal
  "Arctic Region" = "#004D40"     # Dark teal
)

# Calculate node sizes
node_degrees <- degree(g, mode = "all")
min_size <- 3
max_size <- 14
min_degree <- min(node_degrees)
max_degree <- max(node_degrees)
vertex_sizes <- min_size + (node_degrees - min_degree) * (max_size - min_size) / (max_degree - min_degree)

# Create the nodes dataframe
nodes_df <- data.frame(
  id = 1:length(V(g)),
  label = V(g)$name,
  group = V(g)$continent,
  value = vertex_sizes,
  title = paste0("<p><b>", V(g)$name, "</b><br>",
                "Continent: ", V(g)$continent, "<br>",
                "Connections: ", node_degrees, "</p>")
)

# Add color information separately to avoid data.frame conversion issues
nodes_df$color <- lapply(V(g)$continent, function(cont) {
  if(cont %in% names(continent_colors)) {
    list(
      background = continent_colors[cont],
      border = continent_colors[cont],
      highlight = list(
        background = continent_colors[cont],
        border = "#FFFF00"
      )
    )
  } else {
    list(
      background = "#808080",
      border = "#808080",
      highlight = list(
        background = "#808080",
        border = "#FFFF00"
      )
    )
  }
})

edges_df <- as.data.frame(get.edgelist(g, names = FALSE))
colnames(edges_df) <- c("from", "to")

# Create interactive network visualization
visNetwork(nodes_df, edges_df, main = "Country Relationships Network") %>%
  visOptions(
    highlightNearest = list(
      enabled = TRUE,
      degree = 1,
      hover = TRUE
    ),
    selectedBy = list(
      variable = "group",
      values = unique(V(g)$continent),
      multiple = TRUE,
      highlight = TRUE,
      main = "Continent"
    )
  ) %>%
  visEdges(
    color = list(
      color = "#202020",
      highlight = "#202020"
    )
  ) %>%
  visPhysics(
    stabilization = list(
      enabled = TRUE,
      iterations = 100,
      fit = TRUE,
      onlyDynamicEdges = FALSE,
      updateInterval = 50
    ),
    barnesHut = list(
      gravitationalConstant = -2000,
      springConstant = 0.04,
      springLength = 95,
      damping = 0.5
    ),
    minVelocity = 0.75,
    maxVelocity = 50,
    solver = "barnesHut"
  ) %>%
  visLayout(
    randomSeed = 1,
    improvedLayout = TRUE
  ) %>%
  visInteraction(
    hover = TRUE,
    hoverConnectedEdges = TRUE,
    selectConnectedEdges = TRUE,
    dragNodes = TRUE,
    dragView = TRUE,
    zoomView = TRUE
  ) %>%
  visLegend(
    useGroups = FALSE,
    addNodes = list(
      list(label = "North America", color = list(background = "#0D47A1", border = "#0D47A1"), shape = "dot", size = 10),
      list(label = "Europe", color = list(background = "#1976D2", border = "#1976D2"), shape = "dot", size = 10),
      list(label = "Asia", color = list(background = "#B71C1C", border = "#B71C1C"), shape = "dot", size = 10),
      list(label = "Southeast Asia", color = list(background = "#E57373", border = "#E57373"), shape = "dot", size = 10),
      list(label = "Middle East", color = list(background = "#E65100", border = "#E65100"), shape = "dot", size = 10),
      list(label = "Africa", color = list(background = "#2E7D32", border = "#2E7D32"), shape = "dot", size = 10),
      list(label = "Central America", color = list(background = "#FBC02D", border = "#FBC02D"), shape = "dot", size = 10),
      list(label = "South America", color = list(background = "#F9A825", border = "#F9A825"), shape = "dot", size = 10),
      # list(label = "AsiaEurope", color = list(background = "#6A1B9A", border = "#6A1B9A"), shape = "dot", size = 10),
      list(label = "Oceania", color = list(background = "#00838F", border = "#00838F"), shape = "dot", size = 10),
      list(label = "Arctic Region", color = list(background = "#004D40", border = "#004D40"), shape = "dot", size = 10)
    ),
    width = 0.15,
    position = "left",
    main = "Continents"
  )
```
